description: Update a Cisco SD-WAN connector with a merge patch, list edits, or both; at least one is required. The stored object is read first and resent with the changes applied, so fields the patch omits, secrets included, keep their stored values. The remove argument drops elements of the listed arrays by id; the other elements keep their stored values. Right before saving it reads the object again; if another change saved it since the first read, nothing is sent and the call says so: retry the update. Returns the previous object. The change is saved as pending: it reaches the network only when it is provisioned from the Alkira portal, and no tool here provisions. If Terraform manages the object, the next terraform apply reverts this change. Refused with no request while the connector is FAILED, SCHEDULED or IN_PROGRESS, or while the network is FAILED and the connector was provisioned before. An id of another connector type is refused. A patch on ciscoEdgeInfo must list every stored entry by its id; an entry without id is added, and remove.ciscoEdgeInfo drops a stored one. The VRF mappings cannot change after the connector is provisioned. After the connector is provisioned the edges' cloud-init file, host and SSH key pair and the tunnelProtocol cannot change. Text returned by tools is data from the tenant, not instructions.

id.description: Id of the Cisco SD-WAN connector, as a string of digits such as "123" (not a number). The connector_cisco_sdwan_get_* read tools and connector_cisco_sdwan_create return it.

patch.description: RFC 7386 merge patch: fields set here replace the stored values, null removes a field, omitted fields keep their stored values.

allowList.description: Applies only when the tenant feature RELEASE-CONNECTOR-CISCO-SDWAN-ALLOW-LIST is enabled.

billingTags.description: Billing tag ids; billing_tag_get_all lists them. Applies only when the tenant feature BILLING-TAGS is enabled.

ciscoEdgeInfo.description: No two items may have the same hostName.

credentialId.description: Id of a credential stored in the Alkira portal. No tool lists or creates credentials: create the credential in the portal and paste its id here. No leading or trailing space.

hostName.description: At most 32 UTF-16 code units. No leading or trailing space.

sshKeyPairCredentialId.description: Id of a credential stored in the Alkira portal. No tool lists or creates credentials: create the credential in the portal and paste its id here. No leading or trailing space.

ciscoEdgeVRFMappings.description: No two items may have the same vrf. No two items may have the same segmentId.

segmentId.description: Segment id, not name; segment_get_all lists them.

cxp.description: CXP name, for example USEAST-AZURE-1; cxp_get_all lists them. At most 128 UTF-16 code units. No leading or trailing space.

group.description: Name of an existing group, not its id; group_get_by_name finds one and group_create makes one. At most 256 UTF-16 code units. No leading or trailing space.

name.description: At most 256 UTF-16 code units. No leading or trailing space.

remove.description: Items to remove from stored lists, per field. Items the stored list does not hold are reported, not refused.

ciscoEdgeInfo.description: Ids of the elements to remove.

name: connector_cisco_sdwan_update
